announcements.t: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has submitted to the Exchange a copy of the Srutinizer's report of the 7th Annual General Meeting held on September 25, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results. |SUBJECT: Shareholders meeting
